verdict.rationale: Secureframe provides an auditor-approved policy template library and a policy editor with AI-powered revisions and attributes like policy owner/date modified, supporting the template+editor part of the story. However, the evidence pack lacks any explicit mention of a formal approval workflow, version history, or per-employee policy acceptance/attestation tracking. missing for 10: explicit policy approval workflow, version history/audit trail for policies, per-employee acceptance tracking evidence.
